title: Humility in the Life of Jesus
reading:
Jesus lived in constant dependence on the Father. "I can do nothing of Myself." His power flowed from surrender.

Humility is not thinking less of yourself; it is not thinking independently of God.
reflection: Do I pray before acting — or after failing? What would change if I truly believed I could do nothing apart from Christ? Is my ministry fueled by ambition or dependence?
abide: "I can do nothing of Myself." Let those words rest on your heart. Not as defeat — as liberation.
